text:
sarah_cs: Quick kickoff — Concorda signed SOW for embeddings + chat assist. Goal: 30d starter rollout, then scale. Primary success metrics: embed accuracy on pilot set, 95th p95 gen latency, and adoption by pilot team. @aj_solutions @lina_onboard @mike_pmo please chime in with owners and immediate risks. :wave:

aj_solutions: Ack, sounds good. I'll own product acceptance criteria. Proposing concrete targets: 1) embedding similarity ROC AUC >0.88 on the trial dataset; 2) p95 response time <= 250ms for chat on hosted/dedicated; 3) 3 pilot users NPS >= 4 after 2 weeks.

lina_onboard: Noted. Concorda requested VPC peering + customer-managed KMS. That pushes this towards Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC. Need infra intake by EOD Wed to hit 30d. Risk: cert approvals may add 7-10 days.

harpreet_eng: From runtime side, model choice recs: smaller Llama variant quantized for embeddings, and GPT-like 6B for chat with KV caching. I'll draft a perf profile and cost estimate. If we need burst capacity during pilot, flag and we can provision.

mike_pmo: I'll own timeline and facilitator. Proposed high-level milestones: kickoff, infra intake, enablement workshop, pilot launch, 14d check, 30d review. Folks — do these milestones work? I'll book a recurring 30/60/90. :calendar:

sarah_cs: Agree. Quick note on renewal risk: Concorda is regulated (health data) and legal wants stricter audit logs. Flagging medium renewal risk until KMS + audit plan is signed off. We should add a compliance signoff gate before pilot.

aj_solutions: Good call. Adding compliance gate to acceptance criteria. Also want a short enablement checklist for pilot users (4-6 prompts, examples, fallback behavior). Can someone own that? @lina_onboard or @sarah_cs?

lina_onboard: I can draft the enablement checklist with Sarah. Will include sample prompts, allowed PII handling, and escalation path.

onboard-bot: New onboarding checklist created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/concorda/onboarding-checklist — owners: mike_pmo, sarah_cs, lina_onboard. (auto-post)

harpreet_eng: Action items I see: 1) Perf profile + cost estimate (harpreet) 2) Infra intake + KMS plan (lina) 3) Enablement checklist + user prompts (sarah + lina) 4) Timeline + meeting invites (mike) 5) Compliance signoff owner (aj)

sarah_cs: Assigning deadlines: perf profile by Tue EOD, infra intake doc by Wed EOD, enablement checklist by Thu, timeline invites by tomorrow. I'll update the tracker and ping owners mid-week.

mike_pmo: I'll schedule the enablement workshop for next Thu 10am PT unless anyone objects.

aj_solutions: No objections. Also request a small eval set from Concorda (50 queries + golden labels) for embedding validation. I'll email their product lead today.

lina_onboard: Noted — please cc infra@redwood so peering request gets priority.

sarah_cs: Great, thanks team. I'll post a one-pager summary after sync and close the loop. :thumbsup:
